exposure: Cesarean section due to difficulty in labor
outcome: Minimum dose of bolus oxytocin needed for effective uterine contraction
cohort: 83 women undergoing cesarean section, divided into elective (n=41) and cesarean section due to difficulty in labor (n=42) groups.
finding: The minimum effective dose of oxytocin was 1 IU for elective cesarean and 1-1.5 IU for cesarean due to labor dystocia, suggesting that lower doses may be sufficient for effective uterine contraction and potentially reduce side effects.
